modelRouting.routingRationale: M0 is bounded source inspection and deterministic contract generation; independent inventories run in earliest wave, synthesis waits for frozen inputs, and downstream dispatch compilation waits for synthesis.

objective: Rebaseline Legion native-Rust migration against current main, freeze M0 contracts, and compile one exact M1-M8 implementation dispatch packet without product-runtime edits.

waveExecutionPolicy.preflight: Before a wave starts, none of that wave's allowlisted paths may already be dirty. Accepted outputs from completed waves and the dispatch packet artifacts are permitted.
waveExecutionPolicy.activeWaveGuard: While one or more dependency-eligible waves are active, permit dirty paths only from dispatch packet artifacts, accepted completed-wave outputs, and the union of every currently active wave's lane allowlists. Never apply a lane-local dirty-path guard while peer lanes are running.
waveExecutionPolicy.barrier: After every active wave finishes, reconcile each changed path to exactly one owning lane; require each lane's actual changed paths to equal its exact allowlist, reject missing, overlapping, foreign, or unplanned paths, then mark the wave accepted before any dependent wave starts.
